name: app-user-journey-map-grid-with-emoji-emotions-and-pastel-rows
title: User journey map: persona, scenario, goals and an eight-stage grid of activities, pain points, touchpoints and emoji emotions
whatItIs: A light grey board '07 User Journey Map' with three frosted cards (Jenny Wilson persona, Scenario, Goals and Expectations) above a grid of eight lilac stage headers (Discover to Support) and rows for Activities (blue), Pain Points (red row header with pink cells), Touch points (blue) and Emotional with emoji faces and words, where the most positive stage is highlighted in lilac.
whatItMeans: Clear and humane; colour-coded rows and emojis make a journey scannable.
techniques: Colour-code rows: blue for facts, red for pain.
Highlight the best moment in lilac.
Frost the persona cards on top.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of stages, actions and feelings.
A label at the top of each phase.
A row showing feeling with emoji.
One column emphasised in a different colour.
